fact: The op-ed by Issam Khayf Allah says more than 10,000 rural areas have been covered with 3G and 4G networks within the national high-speed plan (al-mukhattat al-watani lil-sabib al-ali), giving no period for the plan; the date is the document's 'late 2025' framing for the connectivity figures.

The Digital Morocco 2030 brochure lists PNHD 2 (Plan National du Haut Debit 2), a program to cover areas with little to no coverage, as aiming to cover 1,800 localities; it gives no plan period, and the date used is the document's published date of 2024-09-18.
